title: 5-Amino-1MQ
description:
5-Amino-1MQ – Research Grade Peptide Standard | Lyophilized Lab Monograph

Classification & Category

Metabolic Signaling & Incretins / In-Vitro Reference Grade

Product Overview & Research Rationale

5-Amino-1MQ is a high-purity laboratory reference peptide supplied as a sterile lyophilized cake. Selective Small-Molecule Nicotinamide N-Methyltransferase (NNMT) Inhibitor Standard. Formulated specifically for controlled in-vitro cellular signaling assays, receptor-binding affinity studies, bioenergetic kinetic modeling, and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) calibration.

Pharmacological Profile & Mechanism of Action

5-Amino-1MQ (5-Amino-1-methylquinolinium) is a small-molecule, membrane-permeable selective inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT). NNMT is an intracellular enzyme predominantly expressed in adipose and liver tissues that catalyzes the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) to nicotinamide (NAM), generating 1-methylnicotinamide (1-MNA). By inhibiting NNMT, 5-Amino-1MQ prevents the depletion of intracellular NAD+ and preserves S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) pools, reversing metabolic dysfunction associated with obesity and cellular senescence. Elevated NAD+ levels activate sirtuin-1 (SIRT1) and AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling cascades, upregulating mitochondrial biogenesis, increasing cellular respiration, and promoting white-to-beige adipocyte phenotypic switching. Preclinical research demonstrates enhanced muscle contractile force, accelerated myofiber regeneration, and significant reductions in adiposity without central nervous system appetite suppression.

Physicochemical & Molecular Specifications

• Chemical Sequence / Formula: C10H11N2+ (Iodide salt)

• CAS Registry Number: 42464-96-0

• Molecular Weight: 286.11 g/mol

• Physical State: Lyophilized Solid Powder (Sealed Glass Vial)

Aseptic Reconstitution & Laboratory Handling Profile

• Target Diluent: Sterile Deionized Water USP or Polyethylene Glycol (PEG-400) Research Vehicle

• Standard Reconstitution Ratio: 10 mL per 500 mg (50 mg/mL)

• Dissolution Technique: Introduce 10.0 mL sterile solvent slowly into the 500 mg powder. Swirl or vortex gently for 90 seconds until the yellow crystalline salt is completely dissolved into a clear, uniform yellow solution. Avoid vortexing or violent agitation to preserve secondary peptide conformation.

• Lyophilized Storage: -20°C in dry desiccator (24 months)

• Reconstituted Solution Stability: 2°C–8°C refrigerated; use within 30 days. Protect from direct sunlight and repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

Intended Use & Compliance Notice

All materials supplied by Research Compounds are synthesized strictly for in-vitro laboratory research, analytical calibration, and scientific evaluation only. Not for human, veterinary, therapeutic, cosmetic, or clinical administration. Research Use Only (RUO).

title: AOD-9604
description:
AOD-9604 – Research Grade Peptide Standard | Lyophilized Lab Monograph

Classification & Category

Metabolic Signaling & Incretins / In-Vitro Reference Grade

Product Overview & Research Rationale

AOD-9604 is a high-purity laboratory reference peptide supplied as a sterile lyophilized cake. Modified C-Terminus hGH Fragment 177–191 Lipolytic Research Standard. Formulated specifically for controlled in-vitro cellular signaling assays, receptor-binding affinity studies, bioenergetic kinetic modeling, and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) calibration.

Pharmacological Profile & Mechanism of Action

AOD-9604 is a synthetic peptide fragment corresponding to the C-terminal region of human growth hormone (hGH amino acids 177–191), stabilized with an additional tyrosine residue at the N-terminus and an internal cyclic disulfide bridge (Cys182-Cys189). Originally developed to isolate the lipolytic actions of growth hormone from its somatotropic effects, AOD-9604 stimulates lipolysis and inhibits lipogenesis in adipocytes without binding the classical growth hormone receptor (GHR). Consequently, it does not stimulate IGF-1 synthesis, alter insulin sensitivity, or trigger cellular proliferation. Mechanistically, AOD-9604 upregulates beta-3 adrenergic receptor (beta3-AR) expression in adipose tissue and stimulates adipose triglyceride lipase (ATGL) and hormone-sensitive lipase (HSL) activity. In musculoskeletal research, AOD-9604 also displays chondrogenic and cartilage reparative properties, enhancing hyaline cartilage matrix proteoglycan deposition in articular chondrocyte cultures.

Physicochemical & Molecular Specifications

• Chemical Sequence / Formula: Tyr-Leu-Arg-Ile-Val-Gln-Cys-Arg-Ser-Val-Glu-Gly-Ser-Cys-Gly-Phe (Disulfide bridge Cys7-Cys14)

• CAS Registry Number: 221231-10-3

• Molecular Weight: 1815.1 g/mol

• Physical State: Lyophilized Solid Powder (Sealed Glass Vial)

Aseptic Reconstitution & Laboratory Handling Profile

• Target Diluent: Bacteriostatic Water USP (0.9% Benzyl Alcohol)

• Standard Reconstitution Ratio: 2 mL per 5 mg (2.5 mg/mL)

• Dissolution Technique: Inject 2.0 mL diluent slowly down the glass wall. Gently swirl in a horizontal circular motion for 45 seconds. Do not vortex. Avoid vortexing or violent agitation to preserve secondary peptide conformation.

• Lyophilized Storage: -20°C dry freezer (24 months)

• Reconstituted Solution Stability: 2°C–8°C refrigerated; use within 28 days. Protect from direct sunlight and repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

Intended Use & Compliance Notice
